title: The Standing Horn
notes: Bible 7.1 posture and 3.5: Hornfolk menhir, hands over its ears. A runic base-line, translated. Horn-role source (object).

pages.text:
(A tall grey stone, a figure cut into it with both hands over its ears. Along the base, in blocky runes, someone has scratched a translation with a nail.)

WE HOLD. WE LISTEN TO NOTHING. THE WARDEN WALKS SO THAT YOU MAY SLEEP.
